title: Qualcomm CEO reveals AI companies want phones running 100-billion-parameter models continuously by 2028.
script:
Qualcomm chief executive Cristiano Amon says artificial intelligence developers want phones running one-hundred-billion-parameter models continuously by twenty-eight.
Running models of that scale completely on Snapdragon hardware requires major engineering advances.
Current mobile processors handle smaller on-device tasks, but local execution for huge models is the next target.
Qualcomm engineers are pushing for local processing to avoid cloud latency and data privacy risks.
Will your next mobile device run a massive model locally without internet connection?
